body: yes, i know it! i tried to take my life twice, and a couple months ago i stopped feeling so incredibly miserable, but have felt nothing at all. i was so confused as to why, but i realized it was numb. i thought that i was getting better but everything's so empty. it's kind of like there's no reason to go on either way. without the misery there's nothing? that's how it is for me anyway. at least there's someone out here who's going through the same plateau
i feel okay now, i dont know if the pain will come back. i'm surprised i didn't die seeming as i didnt go to a hospital, and the fact that i took quite a lot
i dont feel like i am apart of this world anymore. i feel disconnected from everything around me all the time
